content: {"episode_id":"ep-05217","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-29","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome, alongside a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks; the case lists diagnoses I49.5 and G45.9.
